text:
Aisha (CS): Quick one: drafting a one-screen 'starter sprint' health check that AMs run in the first 48h. Needs to catch onboarding blockers, early renewal signals, and gather quick product feedback.
Tom (Solutions): Nice. Can we make it copy-pasteable into kickoff notes + include a tiny prefill command and a shareable feedback link?
Aisha (CS): Yes — keep it tiny. Put the four checks first, then the curl and feedback line.
Aisha (CS): CHECKS (paste in kickoff):
Aisha (CS): - Prefill run in last 24h? (yes/no)
Aisha (CS): - Warm pool reserved (2 sessions for 24h)? (yes/no)
Aisha (CS): - Streaming fallback enabled? (yes/no)
Aisha (CS): - 5 sample prompts captured for eval? (yes/no)
Raj (Eng-SRE): Ops notes: set warm_pool.min=2 for 24h, attach healthcheck GET /healthz after creation, and ensure idempotency key for prefill calls.
Elena (PM): Renewal signal rule: if active_queries_day7 < 0.35 * avg(day1-3) OR weekly_retention_drop > 45% then mark as "activation-risk" and schedule a 1:1.
Tom (Solutions): One-line prefill (safe/idempotent):
Tom (Solutions): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TRIAL-ACME","idempotency_key":"starter-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"onboard_welcome"},{"type":"history","last_n":25}]}'
```
Aisha (CS): Small customer-facing note to paste: "We pre-populated a few examples to speed up initial replies. This improves quality and first-response time. Reply here if you'd rather we not run this."
Raj (Eng-SRE): Telemetry to watch: p50 latency > 400ms, p99 > 1200ms, streaming_error_rate > 1%, 5xx_rate > 0.5%. Add event for prefill_failures per-tenant. Route to #oncall-infra + tag assigned AM.
Elena (PM): Feedback capture: add quick public survey URL in kickoff notes so AMs can paste it to customers: https://redwood.ai/s/quick-start-feedback (one-question: "First impressions? speed/quality/other").
Aisha (CS): AM pasteable snippet for notes: 
Aisha (CS): - Prefill: ___ (ts)
Aisha (CS): - Warm pool: ___ (active yes/no)
Aisha (CS): - Ev evals: ___ prompts captured
Aisha (CS): - Customer note sent: link to survey
Tom (Solutions): UX guidance: recommend batch_size=2 for live chat, batch_size=6-8 for batch/rerank, and trim older history to keep avg seq length < 1024 during trial.
Raj (Eng-SRE): Demo tip: ask ops-bot to mute deploy alerts for short demos: `ops-bot mute deploys 30m tenant:TRIAL-ACME`
ops-bot: OK — deploy alerts muted for 30 minutes for tenant:TRIAL-ACME :white_check_mark:
Elena (PM): Add this starter sprint to renewal playbook as "48h health check + day7 pulse". Day7 pulse triggers enablement if any of the checks are NO.
Aisha (CS): I'll add the 1-pager to the CS templates and include curl + survey link. Tagging @Tom to add a tiny sequence image (prefill -> warm pool -> streaming fallback). Thanks all. :rocket:
